name: FFS_ACTIVITY_TYPE
description: Contains a complete list of activity types registered in the system.

columns.name: TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the activity type.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: It is a text label of the type. The activity type labels are unique inside of the same company.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: It is a status of the type. The status controls an ability to select this type in GUI for a new object.

columns.name: NODE_TYPE
columns.description: It defines if this type is a group or a particular item.

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: It is a reference to a group of types. Please also note that the system also allows to include one group into another one.

columns.name: FEATURES
columns.description: It is a bitmask field that defines active features for this activity type.

columns.name: PENDING_COLOR
columns.description: These are values of colors for the 'pending' status of activities and teamworks. Value example: FFDE00.

columns.name: STARTED_COLOR
columns.description: These are values of colors for the 'started' status of activities. Value example: FFDE00.

columns.name: COMPLETE_COLOR
columns.description: These are values of colors for the 'complete' status of activities. Value example: FFDE00.

columns.name: SUSPENDED_COLOR
columns.description: These are values of colors for the 'suspended' status. Value example: FFDE00.

columns.name: CANCELLED_COLOR
columns.description: These are values of colors for the 'cancelled' status of activities. Value example: FFDE00.

columns.name: NOTDONE_COLOR
columns.description: These are values of colors for the 'notdone' status of activities. Value example: FFDE00.

columns.name: NOT_ORDERED_COLOR
columns.description: It is a value of color for a non-ordered 'pending' activity or teamwork. It has a higher priority than 'pending_color'.

columns.name: WARNING_COLOR
columns.description: It is a value of color for an activity or a teamwork with a warning. It has the highest priority.

columns.name: SEGMENT_MIN_DURATION
columns.description: Multi-day activities: Minimal duration of a single segment (minutes).

columns.name: SEGMENT_MAX_DURATION_PER_DAY
columns.description: Multi-day activities: Maximal total duration of segments created for a particular day (minutes).

columns.name: SEGMENT_ROUND_TO
columns.description: Multi-day activities: Rounding of duration values for generated segments (minutes).

columns.name: SEGMENT_SW_RESERVATION
columns.description: Multi-day activities: Minimum amount of time available that should be before end of service window (percent of total SW length).

columns.name: SEGMENT_MAX_DAYS_TO_SKIP
columns.description: Multi-day activities: Maximum number of consecutive days wo segments that can be skipped because of non-working/overtime/overdue alerts.

columns.name: DEFAULT_DURATION_AVG
columns.description: Default average duration for each activity type.

columns.name: ENROUTE_COLOR
columns.description: These are values of colors for the 'enroute' status of activities. Value example: FFDE00.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).
